title.id: Undang-Undang Mengalokasikan Jumlah Seratus Ribu Dolar Amerika Serikat dalam Mata Uang Lokal untuk Biaya Pembangunan Jalan Kereta Kuda Benguet dari Pozorubio, Provinsi Pangasinan ke Baguio, Provinsi Benguet
title.ms: Akta Mengperuntukkan Jumlah Seratus Ribu Dolar Amerika Syarikat dalam Mata Wang Tempatan untuk Perbelanjaan Pembinaan Jalan Kereta Kuda Benguet dari Pozorubio, Wilayah Pangasinan ke Baguio, Wilayah Benguet

text.en:
The sum of one hundred thousand dollars, in local currency, is hereby appropriated, out of any
money in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for expenses in carrying on the construction of the
Benguet wagon road from Pozorubio, Province of Pangasinan, to Baguio, Province of Benguet.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-six, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 17, 1902.
